title: Endpoint Order Approval Deposit: Amount and Rounding
content:
**Clause.** A deposit is required on an endpoint approval, the approval of a Hardware Procurement Standard Endpoint Order or Staged Endpoint Order quote, when the quote total is at least the order type's deposit threshold, and the standard endpoint deposit is then the order type's deposit percentage of the quote total; no deposit is invoiced on a quote total below the deposit threshold. For both endpoint order types the deposit threshold is 5000.00 USD and the deposit percentage 25 percent, the figures shown for them in the deposit terms.

**Order of settlement.** The deposit-required test on the quote total comes first; the deposit percentage is then applied to the quote total.

**Rounding.** The endpoint deposit is rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount.

The quote total, quantity, unit price and distributor unit cost are those on the quote being approved.

## Threshold and amount, worked (hypothetical quote totals)

| Quote total | Deposit required | Deposit |
|---|---|---|
| 4999.99 | No | none invoiced |
| 5000.00 | Yes | 25 percent of 5000.00, that is 1250.00 |
| 8642.10 | Yes | 25 percent of 8642.10, that is 2160.525, rounded half up to 2160.53 |
